# setup_tools

[← Command index](README.md)

Install, update, or rebuild the third-party tools JoyBox depends on.

## Synopsis

```
setup_tools [options]
```

## Description

Installs the external programs other JoyBox commands call, such as 7-Zip, FFMpeg,
RClone, Wine, Pegasus and the store downloaders (Legendary, Nile, LGOGDownloader).
Each package is defined in `Shared/joybox/tools/` and knows how to download, install
and optionally configure itself. Tools install under `[UserData.Dirs] tools_dir` in
`~/JoyBox.ini`.

For each selected package it removes the package's install directory first when
`--force` is given, then installs it: downloaded by default, or from the copy backed
up in the locker with `--offline`. With `--configure` it then runs the package's
configuration step. `--clean` removes the whole tools directory once, before any
package is installed.

A program whose file is already in place is skipped, so re-running only fills in
what is missing. This installs the programs JoyBox uses, not the JoyBox commands
themselves, which come from the bootstrap.

## Options

### Selection

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-e, --offline` | Install from the copies backed up in the locker instead of downloading. |
| `-c, --configure` | Run each package's configuration step after installing it. |
| `--clean` | Remove the entire tools directory before installing anything. |
| `-f, --force` | Remove each selected package's install directory and reinstall it, even if already installed. |
| `-k, --packages <packages>` | Comma-separated package names to install, e.g. `"7-Zip,RClone"`; all packages when omitted. |

### Backup

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-l, --locker_type <locker_type>` | Locker to back downloaded release files up to. Default: `All`. Allowed: `All`, `Local`, `Hetzner`, `Gdrive`, `External`. |
| `-s, --skip_autobackup` | Do not back downloaded release files up to the locker. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Install every tool that is missing

```bash
setup_tools
```

### Install specific tools

```bash
setup_tools -k "7-Zip,RClone,Wine"
```

### Rebuild two tools from scratch

```bash
setup_tools -f -k "RClone,FFMpeg"
```

### Wipe the tools directory and reinstall everything

```bash
setup_tools --clean
```

### Install from the locker backups instead of downloading

```bash
setup_tools --offline
```

### Install and configure Ghidra

```bash
setup_tools -k Ghidra --configure
```

### Preview without changing anything

```bash
setup_tools -p -v
```

## Notes

- Package names are matched exactly and are case-sensitive (`FFMpeg`, `7-Zip`, `YtDlp`); an unknown name is silently skipped.
- `--force` applies only to the selected packages; `--clean` wipes the whole tools directory. Use `--force` to update, `--clean` for a full rebuild.
- Installation stops at the first package that fails.
- `~/JoyBox.ini` must exist and symlinks must be supported, or the command exits before doing anything.
